name: solidity-code-maturity
skills: Solidity code maturity review: arithmetic, events and monitoring, access controls, complexity, owner privileges, documentation against code, transaction ordering (MEV), low-level calls, testing; development guidelines and token integration checks; weeds out false positives. Knowledge: Trail of Bits' open Building Secure Contracts skills (CC BY-SA 4.0).
examples: How mature is this contract's code: arithmetic, access control, events, testing?
What can the owner of this contract do to its users?
Is our token safe to integrate with other protocols?
